# kwxFFI — C FFI for wxWidgets

kwxFFI exposes wxWidgets C++ classes through a stable C ABI so six language ports can build native GUI applications. Two halves share this repository:

- `include/` and `src/` — the C wrapper library. These headers are the single source of truth for the FFI surface.
- `kwxgen/` — the C++23 generator that parses those headers and emits idiomatic bindings for each port.

Consumer repositories (siblings of this checkout; each uses this repository directly as its kwxFFI source):

| Repository | `--lang` | Generated output |
|---|---|---|
| `../kwxFortran` | `fortran` | `wx/` |
| `../kwxGO` | `go` | `wx/` |
| `../kwxJulia` | `julia` | `wx/` |
| `../kwxLuaJIT` | `lua` | `wx/` |
| `../kwxRust-dev` | `rust` | `wx/` |
| `../kwxTypeScript` | `typescript` | `wx/` |

Generated files in a consumer repository are build artifacts. Never edit them by hand; regenerate them in that repository.

## Ground Rules
- The parsed headers are the contract. kwxgen reads `include/kwx_classes.h` (expanding its quoted includes), `include/kwx_events.h`, `include/kwx_keys.h`, `include/kwx_constants.h`, and `src/kwx_defs.cpp`. A declaration the parser never sees produces no binding.
- Every declaration must have a matching definition; `guard_parity` fails otherwise. The reverse is also a defect: an `EXPORT` definition that nobody declares is invisible to every binding.
- kwxgen skips preprocessor lines. Never wrap a declaration in `#if`/`#ifdef`. Keep declarations unguarded on every platform, use the alias pattern in `include/kwx_msw_aliases.h` / `include/kwx_platform_aliases.h`, and guard only the implementation in `src/`. `guard_lint` treats a guarded declaration as an error.
- Public headers must compile as C99 (the Go cgo preamble includes them). No C++ types, templates, or class bodies in declarative code; a `using` alias is allowed only inside the `#ifdef __cplusplus` block of an alias header.
- Declarations carry `EXPORT` when the definition lives inside `extern "C"`. Without it the definition gets C++ linkage and does not match the declaration.
- One `TClassDef`/`TClassDefExtend` block per class. Repeated blocks merge by class name, and a second block header rewrites the hierarchy — extend an existing block instead of opening a new one.
- Do not edit `src/kwx_constants_table_gen.cpp`. It is generated by the TypeScript emitter, compiled into the DLL, and must stay byte-identical to generator output.
- Wrappers do not validate pointer parameters. Passing null is undefined behavior by design (`docs/decisions.md`).
- Never weaken `tests/`, the guard allowlist, or `tests/expected/symbols.sha256` to make a failure disappear.

## Repository Map
| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `include/kwx_types.h` | `T*` signature macros that carry FFI intent (`TClass`, `TSelf`, `TClassOwned`, `TString`, `TIntOut`, `TBytesIn`, `TRect`, ...) |
| `include/kwx_def.h` | `EXPORT`, `WXFFI_FUNC`, `WXFFI_EXPORT`, `WXFFI_CONSTANT_INT/STR` |
| `include/kwx_classes.h` | Main class blocks plus the quoted include list that assembles every parsed module header |
| `include/kwx_classes_sync.h` | Declarations for exports that previously had no header declaration |
| `include/kwx_*.h` | Area modules (core, dialog, grid, propgrid, ribbon, richtext, net, html, ...) parsed through `kwx_classes.h` |
| `include/kwx_events.h`, `kwx_keys.h`, `kwx_constants.h` | Event exports, key exports, free functions and inline constants |
| `include/kwx_wrapper.h` | Precompiled header: wxWidgets includes, version/UTF-8 checks, helper classes, event macros |
| `include/kwx_glue.h` | Legacy shim only — do not add declarations here |
| `src/wx_*.cpp` | One file per class or class group; implementations return raw wxWidgets objects |
| `src/kwx_*.cpp` | Non-class helpers (`kwx_hooks`, combo, drag/drop, sockets, printout, ...) |
| `src/kwx_defs.cpp` | Constant export definitions parsed by kwxgen |
| `src/kwx_constants_table_gen.cpp` | Generated integer-constant table (do not edit) |
| `kwxgen/src/` | Parsers, model, profile, verify, file writer, emitters |
| `kwxgen/src/lang/` | One emitter per language plus shared policy in `lang_common.h` and type maps |
| `tests/` | Python checks, CTest registration, fixtures, export digest |
| `docs/` | Project overview and design decisions |
| `tools/` | Constant dump helper and `constants_values.txt` |

## Build
Configure once with the default preset (Ninja Multi-Config, Clang, static + shared, tests on):

```sh
cmake --fresh --preset ninja-clang
```

Build from `build/`:

```sh
ninja -f build-Debug.ninja
```

Release, including mirroring the generator to the shared tools directory used by the language repos:

```sh
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .tts/build-release.ps1
```

That script builds `bin/Release/kwxgen.exe` and verifies it is identical to `C:\rwCode\bin\kwxgen.exe`. The consumer repositories resolve `kwxgen` from `C:\rwCode\bin`, so run the Release task after any generator change before verifying them.

Build only the generator:

```sh
cmake -S kwxgen -B kwxgen/build -G Ninja
cmake --build kwxgen/build --config Release --target kwxgen
# -> kwxgen/bin/Release/kwxgen[.exe]
```

## Test
Source checks without a build:

```sh
python tests/run_checks.py --static
```

Full checks (auto-discovers the newest kwxgen under `bin/` or `build/`; pass `--kwxgen <path>` to pin it):

```sh
python tests/run_checks.py
```

CTest, including `parser_tests` and `symbol_resolve`:

```sh
cmake -S tests -B build/standalone-tests -G "Ninja Multi-Config"
cmake --build build/standalone-tests --config Release
ctest --test-dir build/standalone-tests -C Release -L cheap --output-on-failure
```

Never configure the standalone tests into `build/tests`; the root build owns that directory and a second tree there corrupts its Ninja dyndep files.

## Verify the Generated Bindings
After a Release build, verify output in the real consumer repositories. Do not create scratch projects under `.private` and do not delete anything afterwards. Run these from each repository root; `kwxgen.config.json` supplies headers, defs and language, so `--dir` is the only argument needed:

```sh
cd ../kwxFortran    && kwxgen verify --dir wx/
cd ../kwxGO         && kwxgen verify --dir wx/
cd ../kwxJulia      && kwxgen verify --dir wx/
cd ../kwxLuaJIT     && kwxgen verify --dir wx/
cd ../kwxRust-dev   && kwxgen verify --dir wx/
cd ../kwxTypeScript && kwxgen verify --dir wx/ --deno-check --deno-config deno.jsonc
```

The six calls are independent; run them in parallel when the tooling allows it.

Inside any consumer repository:
- `kwxgen` with no arguments regenerates into the configured `out_path`.
- `kwxgen verify --dir <out>` compares committed output against the current headers.
- Generate and verify must use the same profile (all consumers use `full`).
- TypeScript: `kwxgen check --headers ../kwxFFI/include --defs ../kwxFFI/src/kwx_defs.cpp --deno-config deno.jsonc` type-checks into a temp directory without touching the tree.

## Change Workflow
### Adding or changing the FFI surface
1. Add the declaration to the module header that owns the class or area, inside the class's existing block. Register a new module header in the quoted include list of `include/kwx_classes.h` and in `FFI_HDR_FILES` in `files_list.cmake`.
2. Add the implementation to the matching `src/wx_*.cpp` (or `src/kwx_*.cpp`) inside `extern "C"`, following existing signatures. Register a new source file in `FFI_SRC_FILES`.
3. If the class only exists on one platform, add a `using` alias to `include/kwx_msw_aliases.h` or `include/kwx_platform_aliases.h` and keep the declaration unguarded.
4. Build Debug, then run `python tests/run_checks.py`.
5. If the exported symbol set changed on purpose, update the digest (see below).
6. Build Release, regenerate and verify all six consumer repositories.

### Changing kwxgen
1. Read the emitter contract in `kwxgen/src/emitter.h` and the shared policy in `kwxgen/src/lang/lang_common.h`.
2. Change the parser/model or the specific `kwxgen/src/lang/lang_*.cpp`; keep every backend deriving class selection from `ShouldWrapClass()` / `CollectWrappedClasses()`.
3. Build the generator and run `python tests/run_checks.py`; `binding_coverage` compares every backend against the TypeScript reference.
4. Run `kwxgen check` for TypeScript emitter changes.
5. Regenerate the six consumer repositories and inspect the diff. A backend-only change should alter only that language's output.
6. Update `kwxgen/README.md` if a command, option, profile, or output contract changed.

### Updating the export digest
Only after confirming the surface change is intended:

```sh
python tests/checks/export_snapshot.py --root . --kwxgen <kwxgen> --update
```

`--update` rewrites `tests/expected/symbols.sha256`, which covers the complete surface regardless of profile. Never pass `--profile` to `kwxgen exports`.

### Updating the generated constant table
```sh
kwxgen generate --headers include --defs src/kwx_defs.cpp --lang typescript --out <temp>
copy <temp>/kwx_constants_table_gen.cpp src/kwx_constants_table_gen.cpp
```
The emitted file is already in `.clang-format` layout; copy it byte-for-byte.

## Declaration and Implementation Cheat Sheet
- Constructors: `TClass(wxFoo) wxFoo_Create(...)`, implementation `EXPORT wxFoo* wxFoo_Create(...) { return new wxFoo(...); }`.
- Methods: `TSelf(wxFoo) pObject` first, implementation takes `wxFoo* self`.
- Parameters use `TClass(wxType)`; the implementation substitutes `wxType*`.
- Caller-owned factory results use `TClassOwned(wxType)`; methods named `Create*` are constructors.
- Destructors are `void wxFoo_Delete(TSelf(wxFoo) pObject)`.
- Out/in-out scalars: `TIntOut`, `TLongOut`, `TDoubleOut`, `TBoolOut`, `TUIntOut`, `TIntInOut`, `TDoubleInOut`, `TULongInOut`.
- Buffers: `TBytesIn`, `TBytesOut`, `TByteOut`, `TCharOut`, `TIntArrayIn`, `TIntArrayOut`, `TDoubleArrayOut`, `TIntIn`, `TBoolIn`, `TCookie`.
- Expanded geometry: `TPoint(x, y)`, `TSize(w, h)`, `TRect(x, y, w, h)`, with `*Out` variants.
- Arrays: `TArrayString(n, p)`, `TArrayInt(n, p)`, `TArrayIntPtr(n, p)`, `TArrayObject(n, tp, p)`.
- Events: declare `int exp_wxEVT_NAME();` in `kwx_events.h`; implement with `MAKE_EVENT_WRAPPER(...)`.
- Keys: `expK_NAME()`. Constants: `expwxNAME()` or `WXFFI_CONSTANT_INT/STR` in `kwx_defs.cpp` / `kwx_constants.h`.
- Callback hooks: `kwx<Base>_Create(void* pObject, ...)` plus `kwx<Base>_SetOn<Method>(..., void* pFunction)`; value-returning hooks call `Set<Name>Result()` before returning. Match the existing pattern in `include/kwx_hook_exports.h`.

## Where to Get Details
Search the agent knowledge base before reading large files. Articles:
- `kwxgen-overview` — parser → model → profile → emitter pipeline, mixin table, class selection, emitter contract.
- `kwxgen-build-verify-workflow` — command reference, per-consumer verification matrix, test triage, digest and constant-table updates.
- `kwx-ffi-declaration-conventions` — header graph, macro grammar, platform aliases, hook ABI, C-compatibility rules.
- `kwx-ffi-runtime-abi` — ownership, strings, geometry, events, callbacks, helper classes, null policy.

Also read `docs/overview.md`, `docs/decisions.md`, `kwxgen/README.md`, and `tests/README.md` for the authoritative long-form material.

## Stop and Ask
- A public signature, ownership rule, or ABI convention must change in a way existing bindings cannot absorb.
- A test, guard, or digest failure does not have an obvious root cause after one investigation pass.
- Two existing patterns conflict and neither is documented.
